stem: Which of the following is considered an 'Immunization error related' AEFI?

options.text: A patient experiencing a coincidental heart attack shortly after vaccination.
Administering a live vaccine to an immunocompromised patient.
Extensive limb swelling following a DTP vaccination.
An ulcer forming at the site of a BCG vaccination.

explanation: This is a preventable error where a contraindication was ignored or overlooked by the provider.
rationale: Focus on an event caused by a mistake in the decision-making or administration process by the healthcare provider.

optionExplanations.A: A heart attack unrelated to the vaccine is classified as a coincidental event.
optionExplanations.B: This is a preventable error where a contraindication was ignored or overlooked by the provider.
optionExplanations.C: Limb swelling is a vaccine-product related reaction specific to the DTP vaccine.
optionExplanations.D: This is an expected vaccine-specific local reaction for the BCG vaccine.

originalCorrectOptionTexts: Administering a live vaccine to an immunocompromised patient.
